name: sorceress_list_tools
description: List the Sorceress Tool API capabilities for the configured key, including — for image generation — every model with its per-image credit cost, supported resolutions/qualities, aspect ratios, and reference-image limits. Call this BEFORE generating when the user asks what models exist, what something costs, or which model to pick. Returns LIVE data. When reporting costs, copy the EXACT credit numbers from the result verbatim — never guess prices or providers or use outside pricing knowledge. Sorceress credits are tiny (1 credit ~= 1 cent; a single image is typically ~2-18 credits); quoting a per-image cost above ~40 credits is a hallucination.
